summary: Daughter of Edward McGuire and Mary Jane Gaffney, widow of Michael E. Riley of Plymouth, Pennsylvania; probably John's 3rd-great-grand-aunt.
bio:
Mary McGuire was born on 3 November 1858 in the Bloomsburg area of Pennsylvania, the daughter of Edward McGuire and Mary Jane Gaffney, and was twelve when the family was living at Danville in 1870. She is probably a sister of James McGuire, which would make her John's 3rd-great-grand-aunt.

She married Michael E. Riley (1850–1892) and was widowed young. Their children were Celia (1882–1938), Edward A. (1884–1907), James Aloysius (1885–1939), Johanna Gertrude (1886–1957), Mary A. (1888–1950), who married Daniel F. Burns, and Eugene Francis (1890–1918). Mrs. Riley lived in Plymouth from 1880 until at least 1940 and died there on 4 June 1942. She was buried in St. Vincent's Cemetery, Larksville.
